title: EngineInfo
description:
The capabilities of a running engine, as deployed.

Node configs reject unknown fields, so a client checks `features` before sending an optional one. Clients ignore fields they do not know.

build.description: The commit this binary was built from, or `unknown` for an unstamped build.

features.description: Stable ids of the capabilities this deployment honours. Clients ignore ids they do not know.

harnesses.description: Harnesses this build can run. A modelled harness without a driver is absent.

version.description: The engine crate version, compiled in.
